headline: United Airlines bars AI agents from booking or managing flights
summary: United Airlines says it will not let AI agents or personal AI assistants book flights or manage reservations, citing security, cybersecurity and regulatory concerns, including possible DOT and FAA rule violations. One report notes United hasn't yet seen many people try using AI agents to book flights.

claims.statement: United will not allow AI agents to book flights.

sources.quote: United is restricting AI agents from booking flights
United won’t let your AI agent book your flight
United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights, citing cybersecurity risks

claims.statement: United also won't let AI agents manage reservations.

sources.quote: The airline said it will not allow customers to use AI agents to book flights and manage reservations.

claims.statement: United cites security risk concerns, including possible violations of DOT and FAA rules.

sources.quote: The airline believes AI poses security risks and may violate DOT and FAA rules.

claims.statement: United also cites privacy and regulatory concerns, and says it hasn't yet seen many people try using AI agents to book flights.

sources.quote: United says it won't let personal AI assistants book tickets on the airline, citing both privacy and regulatory concerns.
